question: Israel x Iran ceasefire continues through November 30?
resolution_criteria: Yes if no Israeli or Iranian air strike or surface-to-surface missile strike hits the other country between market creation and 11:59 PM Iran time on the listed date. Intercepted munitions, artillery, cyber and ground raids do not count. Resolves with Polymarket market israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-through-november-30.
raise_if: A US-Iran meeting or Hormuz deal is announced
lower_if: Home Front Command drills and airspace closures fire together

history.rationale: 11/07/2026: the crowd's price 64.5% with the horizon's known bias taken out (23 days to go, from the backtest's 30-day map), giving 63.6%. No independent news view. The lead-lag test found no indicator that moves before Polymarket, so the price is the best public starting point.
